title: Store Operations Trainee
responsibilities: Review store performance reports from a back-office workstation
Prepare merchandising and staffing recommendations for store managers
Coordinate with corporate buying and planning teams by phone/email
Rotate through short store visits during the first 90 days only
minimumRequirements: Bachelor's degree in business or a related field
physicalRequirements: Able to sit at a workstation for the majority of each shift
careerPath: Store Operations Trainee -> Regional Analyst -> Regional Operations Manager
